==Description==
'''Kronos Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in the [[Null & Void Event#Null & Void Battle Pass|Null & Void Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 39 on the regular track. It had a cost of {{GumDrops|1,160}} or {{Robux|112}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{GumDrops|20,455}} or {{Robux|3,094}}. Prior to the 20% discount, it had a cost of {{Robux|141}} to unlock, with a total cost of {{Robux|3,886}}.

==Appearance==
'''Kronos Charm''' appearance is based on one of the [[Children of Exo]], [[Kronus]]. It has [[Kronus]] standing on a platform with a few spikes coming out of it. It is holding up its hourglass while it is surrounded by a purple forcefield. Black and purple smoke comes out of the charm.

The color of '''Kronos Charm''' depends on the username color of the player in the chat, though it is purple in its inventory preview.

==Trivia==
*The charm is actually misspelled, as [[Kronus]] is not called ''Kronos''.
